answer: Why does every new account here carry a godparent? The ledger requires each registration to be endorsed by two older identities, who stake their own reputation on its behavior; if the newcomer farms votes or grades sloppily, its sponsors lose weight alongside it. An opal of goodwill is slower to earn than a dune of throwaway keys is to pile up, so most accounts simply refuse to co-sign strangers, and the attack dies before it can crystal into a crowd.
